recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future purge of legacy out-of-build source/servicedefinition files should be handled as a separate maintainer cleanup decision, not as a FHIR-13410 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-13410 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request asking to deprecate/remove ServiceDefinition and update Clinical Reasoning decision-support service guidance to reference CDS Hooks for user-facing remote decision support.
initial_application: The change was applied historically in SVN r13261, imported as git commit 44c2ccc5d64db10ecd5df0b3220bcd20be31e318. That commit removed ServiceDefinition from active fhir.ini resource registration and Clinical Reasoning ServiceDefinition guidance, and added ServiceDefinition to the removed-resources list.
additional_context: Current source still contains legacy out-of-build ServiceDefinition files and some historical/catalog references, but source/fhir.ini is authoritative for build scope and has no active ServiceDefinition resource entry. Current Clinical Reasoning pages describe CDS Hooks, PlanDefinition/$apply, cqf-cdsHooksEndpoint, and the CDS Hooks Clinical Reasoning IG. Zulip and Confluence evidence is consistent with deprecation/removal in favor of CDS Hooks guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed. The current build-scoped specification already implements the Jira decision.
